 CBSE Date Sheet 2027 Released for Class 10 & 12, Check Exam Dates 
 CBSE Date Sheet 2027: The Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE) has released the Class 10 and Class 12 board examination date sheet for 2027. According to the schedule, the CBSE Class 10 and Class 12 board examinations will begin on February 16, 2027. The Class 10 examinations will continue until March 9, 2027, while the Class 12 examinations will be conducted through April 9, 2027.
 CBSE Class 10 Date Sheet 2027 
 Date & Time Subject 
 February 17, 2027, 10:30 AM–1:30 PM Mathematics Standard / Basic 
 February 22, 2027, 10:30 AM–1:30 PM Science 
 February 26, 2027, 10:30 AM–1:30 PM English Communicative / Language & Literature 
 March 3, 2027, 10:30 AM–1:30 PM Hindi Course-A / Course-B 
 March 8, 2027, 10:30 AM–1:30 PM Social Science 
 The Class 10 board examinations are scheduled to begin with the first set of papers on February 16, 2027. The examination window will run until March 9, 2027.
 The Class 10 schedule includes major subjects such as English, Science, Mathematics, Hindi and Social Science, along with language and skill-based subjects. The schedule also specifies separate timings for papers of different durations.
 CBSE Class 12 Date Sheet 2027 
 Date & Time Subject 
 February 16, 2027, 10:30 AM–1:30 PM Physics 
 February 18, 2027, 10:30 AM–1:30 PM Physical Education 
 February 23, 2027, 10:30 AM–1:30 PM Accountancy 
 February 25, 2027, 10:30 AM–1:30 PM Geography 
 February 27, 2027, 10:30 AM–1:30 PM Chemistry 
 March 2, 2027, 10:30 AM–1:30 PM Psychology 
 March 5, 2027, 10:30 AM–1:30 PM English Core 
 March 9, 2027, 10:30 AM–1:30 PM Mathematics / Applied Mathematics 
 March 11, 2027, 10:30 AM–1:30 PM Home Science 
 March 13, 2027, 10:30 AM–1:30 PM Hindi Core 
 March 16, 2027, 10:30 AM–1:30 PM Economics 
 March 19, 2027, 10:30 AM–1:30 PM Political Science 
 March 25, 2027, 10:30 AM–1:30 PM Biology 
 March 27, 2027, 10:30 AM–1:30 PM History 
 March 30, 2027, 10:30 AM–1:30 PM Sociology 
 March 31, 2027, 10:30 AM–1:30 PM Computer Science / Informatics Practices 
 April 1, 2027, 10:30 AM–1:30 PM Business Studies 
 For Class 12 students, the board examinations will begin on February 16, 2027, with papers scheduled across the Science, Commerce, Humanities and vocational streams.
 The Class 12 examination schedule extends until April 9, 2027. Among the subjects listed in the schedule are Mathematics and Applied Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Economics, Accountancy, Business Studies, Political Science, History, Geography, Sociology, Computer Science and Informatics Practices, besides several languages and vocational subjects.
 Where to Download CBSE Date Sheet 2027 
 Students can download the official CBSE Class 10 and Class 12 date sheet from the board's website.
